summary: C1 Explore review requests changes. Revision 046 defines a validator for the physical ActionResult projection, but RunResultFile duplicates executionStatus at the envelope and actionResult levels without an equality invariant. A file can satisfy the current pair table with one top-level status while embedding a different valid ActionResult executionStatus, leaving Policy-facing reconstructed facts inconsistent.

blockingFindings.title: Duplicated executionStatus lacks a cross-field consistency rule
blockingFindings.evidence: RunResultFile has an optional top-level executionStatus and its required actionResult projection also has executionStatus. The allowed-combination table checks only runStatus plus the top-level value; validateActionResultWithoutRunRef checks only that the nested value is valid. No write/read rule requires equality, so completed plus top-level completed and nested actionResult.executionStatus failed is accepted.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Make execution status single-source-of-truth in the physical schema: either remove the top-level field and derive it from actionResult, or require exact equality whenever actionResult exists. Enforce the invariant before write and on read, define how the allowed-combination table uses the canonical value, and add mismatch fixtures that fail closed.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Resolved by revision 046: C1 now owns and specifies validation for the physical ActionResultWithoutRunRef projection.

checks.name: Formal schema-consistency review
checks.result: Reviewed RunResultFile envelope and nested ActionResultWithoutRunRef fields for cross-field invariants.
